description: Source code implementing multitouch device support for Linux using libmtdev within the Kivy framework. Defines classes for motion events and a provider to handle input from mtdev devices, including configuration options and device polling logic.

classes.name: MTDMotionEvent
classes.description: Represents a multitouch motion event with position, shape, and pressure data.

classes.name: MTDMotionEventProvider
classes.description: Provides motion events from an mtdev device, handling device polling, configuration, and event dispatching.

methods.name: depick
methods.description: Extracts position, shape, and pressure data from input arguments to populate the event.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes device polling thread for input device.

methods.name: _thread_run
methods.description: Main loop for reading device data, processing touch events, and queuing them for dispatch.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Dispatches queued events to the application.
